The '''Vendara system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vendara]].
